transport.note: Transport is declared by the operator, never probed. The mathematical core is transport-blind.

engine.head: sg16-seeded-structural-encoder
engine.architecture: Seeded Q16.16 structural encoder used for intent vectors and planning; not a pretrained language model.
engine.offline_online: Local deterministic processing; transport label is metadata only.
engine.note: No autoregressive language-model inference is implemented or wired into this build. Unknown questions are deferred.

identity.utterance: I'm Sovereign SG16 Brain, an AI assistant from the SG16 project. This build uses deterministic code and curated information rather than a general-purpose pretrained language model.
identity.language_parity: UTF-8 input only; language identification, translation, and general multilingual generation are not implemented.

owner.note: Disabled when the server-only secret is unset. Email addresses and browser identity are not credentials.

dodo.note: Configure DODO_API_KEY, DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and one product ID per pass. Paid checkout is disabled when the gateway is not configured. SG16_BILLING_SECRET should be a high-entropy server-only value. Zero-rate regional passes require a trusted proxy configured with SG16_PROXY_AUTH_SECRET.
